source.title: Philip Schaff, The Creeds of Christendom, volume III, fourth edition (1919), pp. 600-673
source.scope: Scripture references in the historical English column; Latin duplicates and bracketed American additions excluded. CCEL OSIS metadata supplies expanded labels, except recorded chapter/verse corrections checked against the printed reference labels. Original labels and note locators are retained. Not a collation with the 1647 first printing.
source.reuse: Underlying pre-1931 edition is U.S. public domain. Only reference data is reproduced, not CCEL site content or commentary. Bible links open the ASV (1901); Bible text is not copied.
